section_01.text_03: Reports, white papers, long-form guides, and strategy work from across my career. Most of it was written for clients, so every piece lives in Google Drive: request access and I'll approve it, usually within a business day.

section_02.text_03: Open any sample and choose **Request access** in Google Drive.
section_02.text_05: Add a quick note about your company and the role, so I know who's reading.
section_02.text_07: I'll approve it, usually within one business day, and Google will email you a link.

section_03.text_01: Want to see something specific? *Just ask.*
